listing.name: Zuma Deluxe (Zuma Portable / CircleShootApp)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Decompilation called fully playable upstream; original-data and BASS dependency documented. Limits: Upstream says fully playable with expected bugs/inaccuracies; source build and separate BASS library remain required. Upstream platforms: Windows source-build scripts using legacy MSVC7 by default; optional64-bit build documented. No observed binary assets; output architecture must follow chosen toolchain/BASS library. Original data: Observed release has no binaries; version-specific data plus BASS redistribution/setup require review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
